title: Exact sparse-spectrum learning algorithm
statement: For each dimension $n$ and sparsity parameter $k$, the construction assigns a membership-query learning algorithm for sparse Fourier hypotheses. For every requested accuracy $psilon\in[0,1/2]$, its program is the exact sparse-spectrum learner for $n$ and $k$; on every Boolean target, its advertised success probability is the probability that the output hypothesis has relative Hamming distance at most $psilon$ from the target. Every execution uses zero random examples, and its membership queries and local work are bounded by the corresponding query and work budgets for that learner.
caveat: The exact learner and its query and work budgets are referenced in the declaration but their definitions are not included, so those bounds cannot be stated more explicitly.
